shots.framing_en: A static medium shot at eye level from the market aisle, both men across the white-tiled counter, Yan Qing on frame left facing north, the butcher on frame right facing south, the stall's five red pendant lamps the only light.
shots.content: 开价：菜市场灯已亮、摊贩理货，闫清直奔猪肉摊问怎么卖，摊主答四十五一斤，闫清嫌贵，心里嘀咕猪肉没这么贵 —— 第一次「钱」的压力。

shots.framing_en: A static medium-close shot at eye level from the market aisle, tighter on the counter surface and the meat between the two men, Yan Qing on frame left, the butcher on frame right raising his chin at the meat.
shots.content: 黑猪肉：摊主说这是上好的黑猪肉、和普通猪肉不一样，闫清凑到案板前看肉身纹理并伸手按了一下，心里觉得看着是有点儿不一样 —— 他在较真，不是被忽悠。
shots._frames_note: 2026-09-21 由 158 改 175（用户拍板）：38 字语音 @5.5 字/秒 需 6.91s，158 帧只有 6.58s，装不下；175 帧 7.29s 密度 95%。这是机械容量问题，不是创作改动。

shots.framing_en: A static extreme close shot at eye level, the butcher's phone screen pushed right up into frame, a truckload of live pigs driving through the slaughterhouse gate on that screen, Yan Qing's face frozen then slowly grinning at the edge of frame.
shots.content: ★ 承重笑点 K1：闫清问是不是早上现杀的，摊主说刚从屠宰场拉回来不信你看看、掏出手机把屏幕怼到闫清脸上，屏幕里一车活猪被卡车拉进屠宰场大门，闫清先愣住再慢慢咧嘴 —— 认真地问、认真地答、证据本身荒谬，不给猪加悲鸣、不变调。

shots.framing_en: A static medium shot at eye level from the market aisle, the butcher wrapping the meat on frame right while Yan Qing loads up his e-bike on frame left, dawn light paling at the market mouth behind him.
shots.content: 五十斤：闫清要五十斤猪肉，摊主笑得合不拢嘴、手脚麻利地装肉并喊小伙子以后多光顾，闫清把小电驴驮满骑出市场，天边开始泛白 —— 第一次下大注，收尾靠天亮讲完时间跨度。
